messages:
Ellie: The new espresso machine arrived! Naming contest time 375 Drop an emoji or reply with a name. Quick options: 
• :coffee: Brewster
• :robot: BaristaBot
• :zap: Steamroller
• :seedling: Beanie

Tomas: :coffee: Brewster all the way. classic.

Jing: :seedling: Beanie 60a cute and short.

Harpreet: BaristaBot 913 for the cyborg vibes.

Sean: Steamroller feels aggressive but memorable :laughing: I vote :zap:

Ellie: also accepting wild write-ins if you have a secret favorite.

Jing: write-in: "Caffeinator" (sue me)

Tomas: haha Caffeinator is a mood.

poll-bot: Poll closed (20m). Results: Brewster 2, Beanie 1, BaristaBot 1, Steamroller 1, Write-ins: Caffeinator 1. Brewster wins :tada:

Ellie: Brewster it is! Will put a little nameplate and take a photo for the #general 'new toy' post. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
